config.description: One shard per file or ArcGIS GeoJSON page (2,000 features ordered by OBJECTID, WGS84, 5-decimal coordinates; long lines/polygons generalized with maxAllowableOffset=0.0001 deg). Layer counts at configuration time: ntad_rail_lines=302771, ntad_rail_nodes=250202, ntad_nhfn=12989, usace_principal_ports=150, usace_waterway_nodes=6255, usace_waterway_links=6859, marad_strategic_seaports=18, ntad_intermodal_rail_tofc_cofc=241, ntad_intermodal_marine_roro=84, ntad_intermodal_liquid_bulk=640, ntad_intermodal_pipeline_terminals=1401, ntad_intermodal_air_to_truck=404. Each layer lists one trailing page beyond the count so modest growth is still captured; regenerate the list if a layer grows by more than 2,000 features.
